sentence: This project uses geologic features made under an ice sheet to find out when a large change in its behavior happened.
This project builds a testbed that combines graphics processing units and field-programmable gate arrays to quickly test hardware for real-time artificial intelligence systems.
This project builds techniques that speed up queries over large video datasets and support more kinds of queries in video database systems.
This project studies whether hands-on manufacturing workshops in a mechanical engineering curriculum strengthen engineering identity and confidence in technical abilities.
This project studies whether the spiny mouse heart can regenerate after a heart attack and which gene pathways help this recovery.
This project builds a tool that measures the performance of deep learning applications so scientists can analyze and optimize them.
This project maps the variety of rocks, landforms and processes in one region of Antarctica and assesses how it benefits people.
This project develops distributed algorithms that pick which interactions between robots a team uses to coordinate stably without a centralized base station.
This project builds computational models that reconstruct how a clinical trial would have unfolded if medical practice had stayed unchanged.
This project builds machine-learning methods that find actively growing supermassive black holes by combining several kinds of observational data into one probabilistic model.
This project makes molecules with expanded architectures and examines their optical, electronic and magnetic properties.
This project builds handheld tachometers that estimate the rotational speed of electric motors from the weak magnetic fields they emit.
This project develops mathematical tools to describe how nonlinear waves behave over long times, focusing on anomalous behavior such as slow decay.
This project studies new wildfire hazards in high-biomass forests and how nearby communities can adapt to them.
